g.title: corrtable
g.text: Assignment object whose domain individual is AdditionalAssignment

g.title: note
g.text: is generated by the Assignment object mapping; an
AdditionalAssignment instance reuses that same object IRI
and Assignment Type. Only AdditionalAssignment instances
generate InviteAdditionalReviewer events. The corr source
must be restricted to that same subset (e.g. by subtype
membership / invitedBy provenance), or it can create
The invitee is identified retrospectively from
AdditionalAssignment.assignedTo when get review X occurs.
